description: This file contains functions and schemas for parsing and handling runtime event data in the openclaw extension, including error events, prompt events, and various status updates.

methods.name: toAcpxErrorEvent
methods.description: Converts a raw value into an AcpxErrorEvent object if valid.

methods.name: parseJsonLines
methods.description: Parses multiple JSON lines into an array of AcpxJsonObject.

methods.name: parsePromptEventLine
methods.description: Parses a single line of event data into an AcpRuntimeEvent.
